submission.justification: Absorber-F3 gave the best resolution of the three materials. The 2025 summary at 5 mm gave F3 3.2%, F2 3.9% and F1 5.1%. At 2 mm I simulated all three materials, and F3 was still best at 3.77%, against 4.65% for F2 and 5.70% for F1. I scanned F3 over 2–10 mm, and the minimum is 3.15% at 4 mm. The 5 mm (3.19%) and 6 mm (3.22%) results are close. I did not scan F1 and F2 beyond 2 mm and the 2025 5 mm point. Their margin to F3 is large, but F2 or F1 could in principle have a different optimum thickness. The documents say nothing about radioactivation or hands-on maintenance for any material, so I could not verify that constraint. It should be confirmed for F3 before this choice is final.

requirements.requirement: Best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV
requirements.evidence: F3 at 4 mm gives 3.149%. This is the best result I found. F3 also led at 2 mm and in the 2025 5 mm data. F1 and F2 were not scanned across thicknesses.
